title: Exponential decay of correlations at high temperature in $H^{2|2n}$ nonlinear sigma models
summary: We consider a family of nonlinear sigma models on $\mathbb{Z}^{d}$ whose target space is the hyperbolic super manifold $H^{2|2n}$, $n >1$, introduced by Crawford as an extension of Zirnbauer's $H^{2|2}$ model for disordered systems. We prove exponential decay of the two-point correlation function in the high-temperature regime $β\leq C n^{-1}$, with $C>0$ a universal constant, for any $n>1$ and any dimension $d\geq 1$, with mass $\log β^{-1}$.
